top_signals.title: Etihad Airways CEO on Airline, Fuel Prices, IPO
top_signals.summary: Etihad Airways Chief Executive Officer Antonoaldo Neves discusses fuel price hedging and the risks around the conflict in the Middle East. He also talks about a possible future IPO, saying the airline doesn't have any plans for that. "We can finance our expansion with our own cash flow generation," Neves says. He speaks with Bloomberg's Abeer Abu Omar. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: LX Pantos Sets Its Sights on Global Logistics Leadership
top_signals.summary:
LX Pantos President and CEO Lee Yong-ho discusses how the Korea-born logistics provider is building out its U.S. footprint, digital platforms and installation business as part of a broader push to become a top-tier global player. Lee also details the company's contract logistics strategy, its priority overseas markets and its progress on sustainability commitments.
